description: Startup script for the 'file-tracker-18466' project that manages file tracking via command-line scripts and optionally starts a help server. It handles environment detection, displays banners, and provides usage instructions.

methods.name: print_banner
methods.description: Displays a banner with the project name and description.

methods.name: print_help
methods.description: Outputs usage instructions and a brief overview of available scripts.

methods.name: start_python_help_server
methods.description: Starts a temporary simple HTTP server to serve help information and scripts.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that determines environment, possibly starts the server or runs other detected scripts.
